description:
This beautiful home is not your standard home, its set on a 0.78 acre mature site, is deceptively spacious and has some unique features.

Situated a 2 minute drive from the village of Kilcolgan , it comprises 283 sq.m of excellent family space. 

It presents with lots of options for a growing family - Accommodation provides large bright entrance hall, family room, great kitchen area which connects to a wonderful entertainment room with its own bar, 2 ground floor bedrooms, bathroom, ensuite, office and utility.  At upper level there are 3 further bedrooms, ensuite and principle bathroom.

Recessed to the rear of this mature site is a large purpose built building which comprises exceptional work space & offices .  This comprises c. 280 sq. m
It has many possibilities .

The property is within easy access to motorway for ease of travel eastwards, it just 25 mins from Galway City and its location is rural but with amenities within 3 mins of the property.   It is 10 mins from Oranmore and 10 mins from Kinvara. 

AGENTS COMMENT    a wonderful family home is a most popular location,  this home also offers on site business opportunity.
